show_hn.story_text:
Hi HN! Utpal here, I'm one of the founders of OpenComputer. OpenComputer is an open source cloud coding agent for teams that can run in your own cloud account (AWS, GCP, Azure). We run the agent harness and the sandbox on the same durable VM (architecture in the docs [1]). First commit lands in 24s; the alternatives we benchmarked took 53-72s (benchmarks below [2]). Two other choices: - One VM per team, scalable horizontally. Sessions are isolated in git worktrees.
- Session files are backed up to a repo after every turn, so any session can resume on another VM. show_hn.story_text:

Show HN: Lightweight FUSE-based encrypted, compressed filesystem for Linux
show_hn.story_text: A personal project for digging deeper into Linux system programming, ObFUSEcate implements a file backed virtual block device that automatically performs compression and encryption as blocks are accessed. This virtual device can be mounted via FUSE (requiring no root privileges) to provide, effectively, a "live" compressed, encrypted archive. Written in C++, and intended to have minimal dependencies, it has custom 32 bit arithmetic encoding/decoding, ChaCha20-Poly1305 authenticated encryption, and CRC8 + XOR parity error-correction.

show_hn.story_text: Hi everyone, Board is a way to create, deploy, and fund a trading bot in 10 seconds. My co-founders and I built Board out of our own necessity. show_hn.story_text: I've seen a rising demand for context when AI queries data from different places, so I built a way to provide it. It support Apache Ossie and the context can live in your codebase or my service or both.
